Song Name	Good Morning My Dearest Robot (Hard) by Chroma
Title	Good Morning My Dearest Robot (Hard)
Artist	Chroma
Description	Track 1 from Chroma's album 'A City That Rejoices In Love'. Chroma first gained internet notoriety from their viral 2007 niconico video 'I tried my best to copy Super Mario Bros' where they, having no sense of pitch, tried to transcribe the main theme by ear. Needless to say, they've improved since then! Map by Luciduslux.
